title: Auto Loans: GAP waiver availability, charge and cancellation terms
content:
# Auto Loans: GAP waiver availability, charge and cancellation terms

This table covers the GAP waiver settings of every Auto Loans product at PCB: whether GAP waiver coverage may be purchased with the loan, the one-time GAP charge financed at funding, the calendar days after funding within which a cancellation refunds the full charge, the fee deducted from a pro-rata refund after that window, and the method by which a refund after the window is prorated.

## Settings by product

| Auto Loans product | GAP available | One-time GAP charge financed at funding (USD) | Full-refund window (calendar days after funding) | Fee deducted from a pro-rata refund (USD) | Proration method after the window |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | yes | 695.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | yes | 695.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |
| Auto Refinance Loan | yes | 595.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |
| Lease Buyout Loan | yes | 595.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |
| New Vehicle Loan | yes | 795.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |
| Green Vehicle Loan | yes | 795.00 | 60 | 50.00 | pro rata by remaining term |

## Quick answers

**Which products carry the highest GAP charge?** The New Vehicle and Green Vehicle Loans, 795.00 USD. The Used Vehicle and Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loans carry 695.00 USD; the Auto Refinance and Lease Buyout Loans carry 595.00 USD.

**Is the 50.00 USD fee taken from a cancellation inside the window?** No. The fee is deducted from a pro-rata refund, which applies only after the full-refund window.

**Is the charge paid in cash at signing?** No. It is a one-time charge financed at funding.
